title: Final retirement of legacy in-repository GFS rollback storage
scope: Remove only the validated legacy rollback copy at [REPO]/public/weather/gfs after independently proving the external authoritative publication and all active consumers.

authoritative_evidence.semantic_full_run_validation: 2/2 runs; ten fields; 24 timesteps; complete PNG verification

active_dependency_evidence.development: The guarded Vite middleware served external latest.json, the current manifest and a representative numeric tile byte-for-byte.
active_dependency_evidence.production: The Vite build excludes public/weather/gfs and materializes the catalogue-selected external run into dist.
active_dependency_evidence.validation: The direct publication check and full semantic run validator use external authoritative storage.
active_dependency_evidence.remaining_tracked_legacy_path_references: Historical/current documentation only; obsolete legacy ignore rules were removed and no active consumer requires the physical path.

recovery_evidence.external_authoritative_store: Validated current and previous complete runs plus latest.json remain available.
recovery_evidence.deterministic_rebuild: Repository generation tooling and NOAA source identity remain documented.
recovery_evidence.phase_4e_validation_inventory: External file-level validation inventory remains outside Git with its tracked SHA-256.
recovery_evidence.same_device_duplicate_limitation: The legacy copy is not independent device-loss protection.
recovery_evidence.frozen_lab_identities: 6/6 matched across original and historical roots

human_approval: The Phase 4G request explicitly names public/weather/gfs as the legacy estate to retire after validation.

post_deletion_validation.production_hash_checks: latest.json, 10/10 manifests and representative numeric tile matched external storage
